name: scene_and_depth
caption: 差が立つのは深度不連続の縁だけ(5-b で距離ごとに数える)。

name: subaperture_mosaic
caption: 9 by 9 sub-aperture views; disparity is in pixels per adjacent view.

name: raw_mla
caption: Raw micro-image array with an 8-times-area centre inset; display resize uses Lanczos filtering.

name: epi_pair
caption: Slanted EPI lines encode disparity in px/view; benchmark format is 9 by 9 views.

name: refocus_stack
caption: Twenty-four uint8 refocus frames, 0 to 3 px/view.

name: depth_truth_error
caption: Turbo-like sequential colour for disparity; diverging colour for signed error.

name: focus_snapping
caption: linear は 1.08/1.15 を 1.0 へ、1.85 を 2.0 側へ引く。cubic は恒等線に乗る。生成側の補間はゼロ(Fourier シフト)。

name: texture_breakdown
caption: EPI は SNR 20 で既に -35 %。焦点度は SNR 20 まで持ちこたえ、そこから整数 1.0 / 2.0 へ落ちる。

name: occlusion_bands
caption: 境界から 5 px 離れれば内側の水準に戻る。影響半径は開口の見込み視差(最大 7.5 px)と同じ桁。
